title: Cimicifuga racemosa tea for medicinal use
intro: Cimicifuga racemosa tea is a herbal preparation made from the roots of the American black cohosh plant. It has been traditionally used in herbalism to support women's health, particularly for缓解 menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and hormonal imbalances. The tea is often prepared by steeping the dried root in hot water and is consumed as a calming tonic. It is valued for its potential anti-inflammatory and estrogen-like properties. However, it should be used with caution and under the guidance of a qualified herbalist or healthcare provider.
